annotations.title: Premium over spot checker and US market benchmark

description: Calculate the dollar and percent premium over spot for a quoted price (or target premium %) and benchmark it against today's listed US dealer asks (lowest, 25th percentile, median, 75th percentile, highest, percentile rank, and CC BY 4.0 Bullion Premium Index row). Includes a below-spot plausibility warning when the quote is under melt. Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

metal.description: Use with weight_ozt when the item is not a tracked product.

payment.description: Which dealer price list to compare against (bank = check/ACH/wire, card = credit card).

premium_pct.description: Premium over spot in percent (use instead of price; alias: your_premium_pct).

price.description: Price quoted for one item in USD (alias: your_price).

product.description: Tracked product slug or name with weight (see list_products).

spot.description: Optional spot price override in USD per troy oz (labels spot_source=caller).

spot_asof.description: Optional ISO timestamp for caller-supplied spot.

weight_ozt.description: Pure metal content in troy ounces (use with metal).

your_premium_pct.description: Alias for premium_pct: your premium over spot in percent.

your_price.description: Alias for price: single-unit asking price in USD.

name: premium_over_spot
